content: Individuals with diabetes have an increased vulnerability to infections, making routine immunizations a critical component of their healthcare. 1) Vaccination schedules should adhere to the guidelines established by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) for age-appropriate immunizations. These include, but are not limited to, vaccines for influenza, pneumococcal disease, hepatitis B, and COVID-19. 2) Immunization recommendations should be personalized by the healthcare team, taking into account the individual’s age, overall health condition, and the presence of any coexisting medical conditions (comorbidities).
